canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas; its chrome strip along the window top shows three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; the app content sits inside its white content area below the chrome strip.

layers.description: App header band across the top of the white content area: on the left the bold dark heading "Kanban board"; on the right a rounded text input with grey placeholder text "Add a card…" followed by a blue rounded button with white label "Add".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the browser window content area, above the three board columns.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "To Do" at its top, holding a vertical stack: first a dashed thin grey rounded empty slot of card height indicating the spot the dragged card lifted from, then a plain white card row with dark title "Fix login redirect" and two small grey labels "Edit" and "Delete" at its right edge, then a thin solid blue horizontal insertion line spanning the panel width marking where the dragged card will land, then a plain white card row with dark title "Buy milk" and two small grey labels "Edit" and "Delete" at its right edge.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Leftmost of three equal board columns arranged side by side with equal gaps; the whole drag interaction happens inside this column.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "In Progress" at its top, holding a vertical stack of two plain white card rows separated by a thin divider; each card row shows its dark title text at the left and two small grey action labels "Edit" and "Delete" at the right edge. Card row titles, top to bottom: "Refactor board module", "Draft ADR-004".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Middle of the three equal board columns; untouched by the drag.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "Done" at its top, holding a vertical stack of two card rows separated by a thin divider; each card row shows a small green circular check icon at the left, then muted grey title text, then two small grey action labels "Edit" and "Delete" at the right edge. Card row titles, top to bottom: "Migrate todo list", "Set up CI".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Rightmost of the three equal board columns; untouched by the drag.

layers.description: A floating drag chip: a single white rounded card with a pronounced soft drop shadow, tilted very slightly, held mid-air just above the blue insertion line inside the "To Do" column area, showing only the dark title "Write weekly report" with no action labels.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Topmost layer, hovering inside the first column just above the insertion line; it is the only place this card title is drawn.
